reason: The source Parquet files have no timestamps and the cache is ordered by file/row order. Attack-onset lead time is therefore not a valid chronological early-warning measurement.
supersedes: The prior numeric lead-time calculation used synthetic row-order positions and must not be cited as measured chronological lead time.
required_for_valid_measurement: Timestamped and chronologically ordered traffic windows
Sequential attack labels with a defined onset
Forecast alerts aligned to their actual issuance windows
